fields.name: speedDelta
fields.tooltip: Speed change applied when a ship passes over the pad. Positive = boost, negative = brake.

fields.name: color
fields.tooltip: Tint applied to the pad's renderer so the type is readable at speed.

fields.name: sizeMultiplier
fields.tooltip: Scale applied to the generator's base pad size. Boosts are small (0.3) and must be aimed for; brakes are big (1.2) and must be dodged.

fields.name: floatingOrb
fields.tooltip: Spawn as a hovering orb on the flight line instead of a flat pad on the road.
